reasoning: Lower bound: a1 to h8 requires a total file+rank displacement of 7+7=14; a knight move changes file+rank by at most 3, so at least ceil(14/3)=5 moves are needed. Also a1 and h8 are the same color and a knight changes square color every move, so the number of moves must be even, giving at least 6. Construction achieving 6: a1-b3-c5-d7-f8-g6-h8 (each step is a valid (1,2)/(2,1) knight move: a1->b3 (+1,+2), b3->c5 (+1,+2), c5->d7 (+1,+2), d7->f8 (+2,+1), f8->g6 (+1,-2), g6->h8 (+1,+2)). Hence the minimum is 6.
